theme_rankings.tagline: 🚂 AI의 '밴더빌트' — 실제 업무에 AI 박는 운영자
theme_rankings.why_now: 추론 비용 90% 하락 + 엔터프라이즈 도입 본격. 진짜 텐베거 후보가 여기서 다수.
theme_rankings.risk: 밸류에이션 과열. 매출 성장 30%+ 못 보이면 멀티플 압축.

theme_rankings.why_now: 강한 추세장에서만 사용. 분할매수 + 손절선 명확히 + 자산의 5~10% 이하.
theme_rankings.risk: 장기 보유 ❌. 횡보·하락장에선 음의 복리(volatility decay)로 손실 누적.

theme_rankings.why_now: MSFT·GOOG·META·AMZN 2026 Capex 합계 $400B+. AI 매출 회수 본격화 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 광고·소비 둔화 시 Capex 가이던스 컷 가능. 빅테크 동반 변동성.

theme_rankings.why_now: 인지노동 다음은 물리노동. 2027~2030 진정한 텐베거 가능 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 상용화 시점 불확실. 미래 옵션밸류 비중 큼. 변동성 극심.

theme_rankings.why_now: HBM4·CoWoS·EUV 모두 캐파 부족 지속. 2027까지 수요 가시성 확보된 영역.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 정점 논쟁 + 중국 수출 규제 변동성. 어닝 미스 시 30% 낙폭 흔함.

theme_rankings.why_now: AI가 돌아가려면 전기 필요. 미국 변압기 대기 100주+ → 만드는 회사들 5년치 일감 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: 사이클 후반 진입 우려는 아직 작지만, 금리 급등 시 인프라주 동반 조정.

top_news.title: $370 'Home Alone Sundae' on The Plaza's Menu
top_news.summary: Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss New York City's Plaza Hotel as it is set to welcome events and guests tied to the United Nations General Assembly and the Qatar Economic Forum. The menu includes the $370 "Home Alone Sundae". (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: JOOPITER Head of Sales on Michael Jordan Jersey Auction
top_news.summary: Caitlin Donovan, the Global Head of Sales at JOOPITER, discusses the rapid growth of sports memorabilia as an alternative asset class, saying the category is one of the fastest-growing parts of the collectibles market. JOOPITER, the digital auction house founded by Pharrell Williams in 2022, has put a game-worn Michael Jordan jersey from Game 3 of the 1998 NBA Finals on the market with an opening bid of $10 million. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Shoppers Rediscover Joy of Dressing Up, Suit Sales Jump
top_news.summary:
Bloomberg's Chris Rovzar joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the resurgence in suit sales for both men and women.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: RFK Jr.-Linked Group Offered Access to US Officials for Fee
top_news.summary: A nonprofit group with ties to US Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. solicited payment from companies in exchange for access to top agency officials at an upcoming event. John Tozzi explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: S&P 500 Volume Spikes on $7 Trillion Options Day: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: The last stretch of a busy week for markets saw stocks churning as bond yields rose, with investors also facing the expiration of a pile of options that spurred a surge in trading volume.

top_news.title: When Building Wealth, Don't Be A Hedge Fund: BNY's Levine
top_news.summary:
Alicia Levine, chief investment officer at BNY Wealth, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss retirement planning, building wealth and asset allocation.

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hedge Funds Turned Bullish on Yen for First Time Since Mid-2025
top_news.summary: Hedge funds turned positive on the yen for the first time since July 2025, a noteworthy shift in sentiment weeks after US and Japanese authorities intervened in the market to support the currency.

top_news.title: Specialty Insurer Orion180 Falls 2.8% After $240 Million IPO
top_news.summary: Orion180 Insurance Group Inc. fell 2.8% in its first day of trading after the company raised $240 million from its initial public offering.

top_news.title: Dollar Surges to Best Week Since June on Higher Rate Outlook
top_news.summary: The dollar staged its biggest weekly advance in more than three months after the US central bank signaled more interest-rate hikes are to come.

top_news.title: Savings, Sundaes & Suits
top_news.summary: Bloomberg Money takes the pulse of your financial life, powered by the reporting of our global newsroom. Today's guests: KKR Partner, Head of Global Macro & Asset Allocation Henry McVey and BNY Wealth CIO Alicia Levine. (Source: Bloomberg)
